name: 20 Minute Air-Fryer Cauliflower

ingredients.name: cauliflower, tough outer leaves and core removed

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a 6-quart air fryer to 205°C (400°F) (205ºC) for 5 minutes. Cut cauliflower into 8 wedges, then cut into 5-cm florets (should be about 4 cups total). In a large bowl, toss cauliflower with oil, water salt and pepper until well coated; use your hands to make sure all nooks and crannies are coated with oil and seasonings.

Arrange half (about 2 cups) of the florets into the preheated air fryer basket; cook, shaking basket twice during cooking, until tender and well browned, 10 to 12 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and cover to keep warm; and repeat cooking with the remaining cauliflower. Combine cauliflower and serve.

description: Get dinner on the table fast with our recipe for crisp, tender air-fryer cauliflower. Enjoy it as is, or dress it up with our three easy variations.
notes:
Make-ahead and storage: Cauliflower can be chopped into florets and refrigerated in a zip-top bag or airtight container up to 3 days before cooking.
Air-fried cauliflower can be made up to 4 days in advance and refrigerated in an airtight container. Reheat in a microwave or air fryer preheated to 340ºF (170ºC) until warm.
author: Leah Colins
